narrative.details:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello again, adventurer.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you.

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
narrative.objectives: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Nice job, adventurer. I figure that was a cakewalk for someone in your line of work.As promised, here's the goods.
narrative.requestItemsText: You said you're breaking into Shadowfang...alone? You've got some guts!I can hook you up with explosives to get past the gate, but I'll need a work order to make it look legit on the books. An employee around here's likely carrying one. Probably someone who does a lot of tinkering or building.
